title: Just Mint
tagline: A batch based system to mint and distribute NFTs powered by ChainLink VRF.
description:
We are building a set of tools that improve the creation, breeding, and distribution of NFTs.

Our goal is to provide a lootbox system as service for game developers who need to implement an async reward system. Users should enqueue their request and they eventually get the option to obtain their reward/lootbox.
how_its_made: A loot-box consists of a randomly generated hash, it is constructed using as a source of entropy chain links VRF. The hash can be interpreted and consumed by developers, who are free to give meaning to each bite of the hash. In our case, the first bite corresponds to rarity and the second to color. Randomized async loot service, a gateway to the metaverse, for developers wanting to express rewards as NFTs, so they don't have to reinvent the wheel.
